text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy premier Tareq Aziz arrives in Moscow.
- Moroccan trade minister says: "Morocco supports Iraq economically and politically."
- Saudi diplomat asks for asylum in Germany.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs a cabinet meeting.
- French oil firms Elf and Total hold talks in Baghdad to develop oilfields in southern Iraq.
- A Pakistani trade delegation to arrive in Baghdad on Monday.
